name: Coordinated Cut
text: Designate one target; the platoon gains +150 ATK against it this round.

name: Last Oath
text: When succession occurs, immediately Rally the platoon.

name: Formal Duel
text: Challenge an adjacent enemy elite or leader; other units cannot interfere for one activation.

name: Spear Wall
text: +100 DEF against frontal cavalry attacks while adjacent to another Ashigaru.

name: Silent Directive
text: One allied unit may Hide after attacking.

name: Smoke Relay
text: Create a two-hex smoke area when succession occurs.

name: Twin Echo
text: Create two temporary clones for two rounds; clones have 40% ATK, 1 HP, and cannot grant bonuses or capture objectives.

name: Cut the Thread
text: +150 ATK against ritualists, portal keepers, and support units.

name: Hold the Standard
text: Allies in command radius cannot become Routed this round.

name: Inherited Wall
text: Succession grants the platoon +150 DEF for one round.

name: Diving Charge
text: After moving at least four hexes, gain +250 ATK; cannot use on consecutive rounds. Becomes Exposed until next activation.

name: Shield Lock
text: +100 DEF when adjacent to two Knight allies.

name: Wing Roar
text: Adjacent enemy units lose 5 Morale.

name: Slipstream
text: Succession grants the flight +1 Movement for one round.

name: Crushing Dive
text: After moving at least three hexes, gain +300 ATK; becomes Exposed until next activation.

name: Pack Wing
text: +100 ATK against isolated enemies (no adjacent allies).

name: Channel
text: Contribute Channeling to an adjacent ritual circle this round.

name: Open Reinforcement Portal
text: Call a reinforcement portal at a valid controlled hex; it opens after a one-round telegraph.

name: Measured Advance
text: The platoon may move one hex while maintaining formation connections, then gains +100 ATK on its next melee attack this round.

name: Veil Crossing
text: Up to three members may move through occupied allied hexes and ignore enemy zones of control this activation.

name: Bastion Formation
text: Adjacent Knight units gain Guarded; they cannot sprint during the same activation.

name: Wing Dominion
text: The flight moves in sequence without blocking other members and gains +100 ATK against isolated ground units this activation.

name: Oath Line
text: Adjacent Samurai foot soldiers gain +50 additional DEF when facing the same direction.

name: Unseen Network
text: Hidden Shinobi share vision with their platoon commander.

name: Oath of Intercession
text: Once per round, a Knight adjacent to an ally may become the target of an incoming melee attack.

name: Predatory Airspace
text: Enemies cannot use unrestricted flying movement through a Dragon Flight's command radius.

name: Set Up
text: Emplace the piece. Required before firing; moving breaks the emplacement.

name: Breaching Shot
text: Bonus ATK against portals and against units standing on Fortification, Ruins or Trench.

name: Smoke Shell
text: Lob a smoke shell: the target hex and its neighbours become Smoke for two rounds.

name: Concussive Blast
text: Pressure blast: every enemy in and around the target hex takes 300 damage and is Suppressed.

name: Lance Charge
text: After 3+ hexes of unbroken charge, gain +200 ATK on the next attack, then become Exposed.

name: Hit and Fade
text: After attacking, may immediately move up to 2 hexes without triggering reaction attacks.

name: Shadow Step
text: Relocate up to N hexes to a Forest, Smoke or Ruins hex, ignoring everything between (Kage rank).

name: Surrender
text: The army leader yields the field. The battle ends immediately in the opponent's favour.

name: Warding Sigil
text: Cut a sigil into the air: the platoon gains +200 DEF for the round.

name: Stormglass Burst
text: Shatter a glass charge over the target hex: 420 damage to everything around it, and the survivors are Suppressed.

name: Cobalt Volley
text: Mark a target for the line: the platoon gains +180 ATK against it this round.

name: Creeping Hex
text: Whisper the rot into every adjacent enemy: -18 morale.

name: Briar Snare
text: Thorn growth erupts around the target hex, turning it and its neighbours to Forest for three rounds.

name: Coven Dirge
text: The circle takes up the dirge: this unit and its adjacent coven allies become Guarded.

name: Slit the Purse
text: A knife where the armour laces: 260 damage and the target is left Exposed.

name: Court Signal
text: A whistle down the alley: the platoon gains +2 Movement for one round.

name: Parthian Loose
text: After loosing, may ride up to 3 hexes without drawing reaction attacks.

name: Horn Call
text: The war-horn carries: the platoon recovers 16 morale.

name: Hollow-Bow Volley
text: Range the host on one target: the platoon gains +200 ATK against it this round.

name: Sand Veil
text: Kick up the dune: up to three adjacent open hexes become Smoke.

name: Glassroad March
text: The caravan order: the platoon moves in phases and strikes isolated ground troops for +120 ATK.

name: Sandglass Duel
text: Turn the glass and call the challenge; no one interferes for one activation.

name: Arbiter's Word
text: The Compact's word holds: allies within command radius shed Routed and cannot rout this round.
